repo_notes: N-Zik Website is the official website for the N-Zik app, hosted on Vercel at n-zik.vercel.app.
Zero-build static site: vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no framework, no build step, no dependencies.
The entire site lives in index.html (single page); styles in css/ (style.css, custom.css, fonts.css), scripts in js/.
Localization: four English catalogs under localization/source/ and Crowdin exports under localization/translations/<locale>/; all 48 locales are selectable in the footer.
The i18n loader (js/multilingual.js) fetches strings via fetch(), so the site requires an HTTP server (file:// breaks language loading).
Translations are coordinated on Crowdin (N-Zik project); the footer selector in index.html is updated manually per locale.
The project is based on the website from RiMusic.
Tone: concise, developer-friendly; this is a marketing/landing site, not an application.

page_notes.content: Introduction to N-Zik Website as the official landing site for the N-Zik app (n-zik.vercel.app).
Summary of what the site offers: hero + downloads, feature showcase, desktop companion section, language selector.
Walkthrough of index.html as a single page: section order and how each section is composed.
Hero section, store download badges (GitHub, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, OpenAPK, AndroidFreeware, Obtainium, Appteka) and their target links.
The dedicated N-Zik Desktop Compagnon (Windows & Linux) section: pairing with the phone over local Wi-Fi, download badges.
Feature sections (lyrics, Discord Rich Presence, offline caching, search, OTA, artist pages, queue, history...) with their demo videos from videos/.
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, ScrollReveal (scrollreveal.min.js), no framework, no build step.
How strings are loaded: localization/source/ and localization/translations/<locale>/, js/multilingual.js fetch flow, footer language selector in index.html.

The 48 selectable locales match the directories under localization/translations/. English is rendered from localization/source/. The English export is an optional comparison reference for identifying English copies in other locales.
images/ (banners, get-it-on badges, Screenshots/*.webp, DevGlobe/Discord badges), videos/ (feature demo MP4s).
How to add a translation: configure localization/translations/<locale>/ and add the language to the footer selector in index.html; pull request process.
